save.text: Liam is remote via Internet; visible on Twitch; joked he’s in a Bag of Holding.
Matt & Marisha will be guests at Tekko in Pittsburgh, Apr 8–10; panels and signings.
Gilmore’s Glorious Goods shirt pre-order ends “tomorrow at midnight” per Travis; group uncertain—Matt/Laura advise order tonight to be safe.
Two new shirts went up at 6:30 today; available for 1-week preorder; limited immediate stock; working to expand sizing.
Sam voice-directed DreamWorks’ Home TV cartoon; announced today; releases in a week.
Tonight is episode 47; episode 50 will be special with surprises; Critmas blowout after ep 50.
Marisha: her last episode as Signal Boost host airs this Tuesday; hosts rotate; she still produces the show.
Liam is playing from his childhood kitchen—the first room he ever played D&D in.
Party camped with Pyrah tribe after sealing Fire Ashari gate; Gern Blanston left to scavenge red dragon scales in Cindergrove.
Scanlan cast Mordenkainen’s Magnificent Mansion; created extra‑planar safe lodging with servants and rooms; Vex entered first and confirmed lush foyer.
Scanlan invited the whole Pyrah tribe (~35 incl. Zephrah per Matt) to stay; initial reaction: they kept building shelters, unsure.
Grog attacked three ethereal mansion servants with Craven Edge; swings dispersed them and dropped carried items.
Mansion servants are obedient spectral ‘spirits’; confirm enjoyment as “purpose.” Can materialize items (wine) that become solid inside; dissipate when leaving door.
Scanlan claims MMM is a newly acquired skill; 100 servants total, 50 assigned to him; custom mansion includes separate rooms for party, with Pike and Kaylie rooms near his.
Liam remote via Internet/Twitch; currently playing from his childhood kitchen, first room he ever played D&D in.
MMM servants can admit only invited guests; mansion casting takes 1 minute and is usable once per day.
Scanlan forgot to make a Trinket room; Vex will move her bed to basement training hall with high ceilings; Kaylie’s room is locked; Pike’s nearby; basement used for training.
Servants can fetch limited items; produced a single spectral cow with substance but no blood; dispersed later; they couldn’t get a squid.
MMM mansion includes a basement training hall: sand pit, dummies, chains for climbing, basic weapons and armor racks; access via new doorway in main hall.
Vex moved to train in basement with Grog and Trinket; attempted to ride a broom from Bag of Holding but it did not fly; put broom back and left to find Keyleth.
Servants can fetch limited items; they will handle cleaning per Vex. Earlier spectral cow had substance but no blood; dispersed later; they couldn’t get a squid.
Servants can fetch limited items and handle cleaning per Vex; spectral cow had substance but no blood; dispersed later; they couldn’t get a squid.
MMM mansion includes a basement training hall (sand pit, dummies, climbing chains, basic weapons/armor racks); access via new doorway in main hall.
Vex and Scanlan identified Gern’s broom activation word: archaic Draconic for “candle”; speaking it activated the broom to fly.
Extradimensional top-floor room has ~50-foot-high ceilings with garish drapery; Vex flies Gern’s broom there after speaking its activation word.

Servants can fetch limited items and clean per Vex; spectral cow had substance but no blood; dispersed later; they couldn’t get a squid. Vex now flying stolen broom; agreed to repay by helping someone Scanlan chooses.
Gern’s broom activation word (archaic Draconic for “candle”) works; Vex spoke it and flew, learning control by tilt/concentration.

Cerkonos confides to Keyleth: a girl taken in at Pyrah, Raishan, secretly wielded ancient arcane power and tore open the Fire Ashari Gate months ago, releasing Thordak; she fled. He warns Keyleth to trust instincts and be wary of unproven aid.
Raishan identified as the green dragon of the Chroma Conclave that attacked Emon; Keyleth recalls name; party confirms.
Scanlan’s mansion servants/food; items inside may vanish on exit—group unsure; plan to test but not with broom/Trinket.
Vex admits she stole Gern’s flying broom (necromancer/candlemaker) and intends to keep it; party largely nonjudgmental; Percy asked to examine it.
Grog had a nightmare of Kevdak praising him atop corpses; he wakes unsettled as party finishes long rest in mansion.
Vex tests Gern’s flying broom in mansion; can fly but shaky shooting arrows; asks Percy to build a seat for stability; Percy agrees to tinker, may need funds; Vex will fund.
Keyleth voices concern about Vex’s safety/greed over broom; doesn’t care about returning it; Vex says she’s not afraid to die after seeing the other side; group largely accepts keeping broom.
Party confirms Raishan as green dragon of Chroma Conclave; Keyleth had recalled name earlier; remains accepted context.

Keyleth relays Cerkonos’s visit: Raishan infiltrated Pyrah ~4 years ago disguised as a 15-year-old human; wielded power beyond Ashari; ripped open Fire Ashari rift releasing Thordak; fled; Ashari hadn’t known she was a dragon.
Party reaffirms Raishan is green Chroma Conclave dragon and infiltrator at Pyrah; Keyleth confirms timeline/means; group vows caution about human disguises.
Vex still wants broom seat stability; Percy agreed to tinker; no change this morning; breakfast scene mostly chicken; plan discussion ongoing (sphinx vs. Grog’s herd vs. library).
Group chooses to head toward Westruun area; targets: Grog’s herd for the Titanstone Knuckles; Frostweald nearby; library/sphinx deprioritized.
Grog warns reunion may be hostile: he was beaten and left for dead by his uncle after defying him; herd thinks Grog is dead; uncle owns the Knuckles.
Percy suggests Hat of Disguise to avoid confrontation; Grog refuses and is resolved to face herd openly.
Party reconsiders order: Grog suggests 1v1 duel for Knuckles but wants extra items first; group pivots to visit sphinx in Frostweald before facing herd.
Grog reiterates herd danger: stealing risks lethal punishment; expects custom of single combat with his uncle for the Knuckles; herd size unclear (~six?).
Travel planning: Westruun under Umbrasyl in Gatshadow; closest tree teleport targets are Crossroads or Bramblewood; Keyleth can scry/teleport but recalls no Frostweald trees.
Teleport choice shifts: Keyleth targets Bramblewood near Westruun after failing to connect to a Westruun park tree; recalls marked trees at Bramblewood entrance and opens Transport via Plants there.
Party pivots again: chooses Bramblewood over Crossroads, then uses Wind Walk to travel toward Frostweald/Westruun area.
Current recon: In mist form near Westruun, they spot a 15–20 ft dirt mound with wood spikes, glinting objects, and haphazard grooves; two people haul a cart away from it.
Coins and smashed wood at 15–20 ft mound are offerings; sweeping giant claw marks show a large, fast creature snatches from it repeatedly.
Party lands from Wind Walk near Westruun in tall crops; Vex casts Pass Without Trace. Group stealths successfully (mid-30s avg).
Westruun outskirts: burned patterned farmlands; some active fields. Each farm group watched by an armed guard; thin new outer wall/battlements around city entrances.
Party debates aiding oppressed farmers vs. larger goal; decide they can’t help locals until dragon threat addressed; consider going toward city; stealth still active.
Farmer Reginald (bruised) confirms dragon feared; worse are its enforcers taking/guarding prisoners in/near city; his daughter taken; points out a nearby guard post on farm outskirts.
Dragon over Westruun seen every couple of days; last sighting dusk yesterday (~half day ago).
